data.body: REVISION_CYCLE_1: Capture-point semantics — dd-1 (this task's baseline) IS the canonical 'before' value for dd-2. The 197 baseline captured pre-Phase-1 is also the value bridge-fsck reports immediately pre-bootstrap-strict (Phase 1) which is contiguous with pre-bootstrap-throttle (Phase 2 = capped passes 6-8). No semantically distinct intermediate capture is needed because the 197 count reflects the cumulative orphan inventory at sprint start; the bootstrap-throttle 'after' value (pass 8 anchor) is compared to this baseline. Documented in dd2.json semantics: before_count := dd1.json.label_only_orphan_count (same capture point); after_count := bridge-fsck at post-pass-8.
